fact: In the study, 70 diabetic patients with stable HF were enrolled, randomly assigned to empagliflozin (n = 35) or control group (n = 35) for 6 months.
fact_zh: 在这项研究中，纳入了70名患有稳定型心衰的糖尿病患者，随机分配到恩格列净组（n=35）或对照组（n=35），持续6个月。
quote: we enrolled 70 diabetic patients with stable HF according to the New York Heart Association functional class II–III criteria

fact: After 6 months of empagliflozin therapy, the 6MWTD significantly increased compared with the control group (P < 0.05).
fact_zh: 恩格列净治疗6个月后，6分钟步行距离（6MWTD）显著增加，与对照组相比（P < 0.05）。
quote: the 6MWTD significantly increased, whereas the LA volume index and the E/e′ ratio both at rest and during exercise decreased compared with those of the control group (P < 0.05 for all).

fact: The LA volume index and the E/e′ ratio both at rest and during exercise decreased in the empagliflozin group compared with the control group (P < 0.05 for all).
fact_zh: 恩格列净组的左心房容积指数和静息及运动时的E/e′比值均低于对照组（P < 0.05）。
quote: the LA volume index and the E/e′ ratio both at rest and during exercise decreased compared with those of the control group (P < 0.05 for all).

fact: LV diastolic, LA reservoir and contractile, and chronotropic reserves improved in the empagliflozin group compared with the control group (P < 0.05 for all).
fact_zh: 恩格列净组的左心室舒张功能、左心房储藏和收缩储备以及心率储备均优于对照组（P < 0.05）。
quote: LV diastolic, LA reservoir and contractile, and chronotropic reserves also improved in the empagliflozin group compared with those in the control group (P < 0.05 for all).

fact: Treatment with empagliflozin led to improvements in NT-proBNP and ST2 blood levels compared with those in the control group (P < 0.05 for both).
fact_zh: 恩格列净治疗使NT-proBNP和ST2血液水平改善，与对照组相比（P < 0.05）。
quote: treatment with empagliflozin led to improvements in NT-proBNP and ST2 blood levels compared with those in the control group (P < 0.05 for both).

fact: After 6 months of therapy, the 6MWTD increased by 16 (95% CI 8–24) m in the Empagliflozin group but only by 3 (95% CI–6–12) m in the control group (P = 0.033).

fact: After 6 months of therapy, the exercise duration during the incremental bicycle test increased by 66 (95% CI 33–99) s in the Empagliflozin group and only by 7 (95% CI–10–26) s in the control group (P = 0.002).
